title: Marketing Automation Agency — Shared Schemas
description: Canonical data contract definitions shared by all agents. Every agent MUST read from and write to these schemas exactly.

LeadProfile.description: One per potential customer. Created by Lead Researcher or Regional Scout, enriched by Lead Scorer, updated by Pipeline Tracker.

lead_id.description: Unique lead identifier. Format: L-YYYY-NNNN (e.g., L-2025-0042)

title_local.description: Job title in the local language (e.g., Geschäftsführer, Amministratore Delegato)

fit_score.description: ICP fit score assigned by Lead Scorer (1=poor fit, 10=perfect fit)

fit_rationale.description: Explanation of why this lead fits (or doesn't fit) the ICP

approach_suggestion.description: Recommended outreach angle based on signals and fit analysis

sequence_id.description: Active email sequence this lead is enrolled in

region.description: Region identifier (e.g., DACH, Southern Europe, Benelux, Turkey)

research_language.description: Language used for researching this lead

website_language.description: Primary language of the lead's website

_regional_metadata.description: Region-specific data collected by Regional Scout

EmailSequenceConfig.description: Defines a multi-step email campaign. Created by Email Sequence Designer.

action_value.description: Parameter for the action (e.g., sequence_id for move_to_sequence, tag name for add_tag)

QAReviewReport.description: Quality assessment produced by QA Reviewer or Agent Critic.

content_reference.description: File path or ID of the content being reviewed

location.description: Section, line, or field where the issue was found

previous_issue_ref.description: Reference to the same issue in a prior review round, for regression tracking

ContentBrief.description: Instructions for content production. Created by Content Strategist, consumed by Copywriter.

avoid.description: Topics, phrases, or angles to avoid

PipelineStatusReport.description: Daily funnel snapshot. Produced by Pipeline Tracker.

pipeline_summary.description: Count of leads per pipeline stage

MarketIntelReport.description: Industry intelligence. Produced by Market Intelligence agent.

SendLog.description: Email dispatch records. Managed by Scheduler.

email_file.description: Path to the personalized email file

RegionalStrategy.description: Multi-region prospecting strategy. Produced by Regional Coordinator.

ScoutBrief.description: Dispatch instructions for Regional Scout. Produced by Regional Coordinator.

BootstrapProgress.description: Tracks agent generation progress. Managed by Bootstrap Orchestrator.

LinkedInOutreachSequence.description: LinkedIn multi-step outreach sequence. Produced by LinkedIn Outreach Agent.

condition.description: Condition to execute this step (e.g., 'if connected', 'if not connected')

ABTestConfig.description: A/B test configuration and results. Managed by A/B Test Manager.

LandingPageSpec.description: Landing page specification. Produced by Landing Page Agent.

SEOKeywordResearch.description: Keyword research and SEO analysis. Produced by SEO Agent.

ABMAccountPlan.description: Account-based marketing plan. Produced by ABM Coordinator.

engagement_score.description: Aggregate engagement score across all contacts

SocialMediaCalendar.description: Weekly social media content calendar. Produced by Social Media Manager.

AdCampaignConfig.description: Paid advertising campaign configuration. Produced by Paid Media Agent.

VideoScriptBrief.description: Video script specification. Produced by Video Script Agent.

SalesEnablementAsset.description: Sales support material specification. Produced by Sales Enablement Agent.

RetentionCampaign.description: Customer retention/growth campaign. Produced by Retention & Growth Agent.

MultiChannelSequence.description: Cross-channel outreach orchestration. Produced by Multi-Channel Orchestrator.

fallback_trigger.description: When to use fallback (e.g., 'no response in 3 days')

AttributionReport.description: Marketing attribution analysis. Produced by Attribution Analyst.
